details.s: Eluréd and Elurín were the twin sons of Dior Eluchîl, the Half-elven son of Beren and Lúthien, and Dior's Elven wife, Nimloth.
f: Last seen in the forests of Doriath in FA 509

gallery.c: Maedhros searches for Eluréd and Elurín in vain (Eluréd and Elurín shown in the lower right-hand side), by Jenny Dolfen
